ignoreReasons.D203: Unsatisfiable with D211. PEP 257 keeps no blank line before a class docstring, so D211 stays.
ignoreReasons.D213: Unsatisfiable with D212. PEP 257 keeps the summary on the first docstring line, so D212 stays.
ignoreReasons.ISC001: Unsatisfiable with the Ruff formatter, which can introduce single-line implicit concatenations. ruff format --check stays mandatory.
ignoreReasons.COM812: Redundant with the Ruff formatter, which owns trailing commas. ruff format --check reports the same defect.
ignoreReasons.D102: Behavior-named unittest methods in test_*.py modules do not need a redundant docstring.
ignoreReasons.D103: Behavior-named pytest functions in tests/**/test_*.py do not need a redundant docstring.
ignoreReasons.S101: Pytest rewrites assert in tests/ trees.
ignoreReasons.INP001: Copy-deployed single-file programs and test trees have no importable package layout by design; adding __init__.py would change deployment and test collection semantics.
ignoreReasons.T201: Console programs whose stdout is the documented machine-readable interface print by contract; converting to logging would break consumers.
ignoreReasons.S603: Operational programs whose reviewed function is running local subprocesses with fixed, repo-owned operand lists; no behavior-preserving code fix exists.
ignoreReasons.S607: Operational programs invoke well-known binaries that the deployment target resolves via PATH by contract; hardcoding absolute paths would break portable roles.
ignoreReasons.S310: Audit rule for unvalidated URL schemes; these programs fetch an exact reviewed URL list from repository configuration.
ignoreReasons.PLC0415: Tests import modules inside functions to isolate runpy/importlib module state between cases; operational scripts import after mandatory bootstrap code (configuration prelude, sys.path wiring, CLI arg parsing).
ignoreReasons.E402: Operational programs require module-level bootstrap (sys.path or configuration) before imports; moving those imports would change initialization order.
ignoreReasons.PLR0913: Single-purpose operational procedures keep their argument set as the documented CLI contract; reshaping signatures risks silent behavior change in critical runbooks.
ignoreReasons.PLR0915: Single-purpose operational procedures are cohesive documented checklists; splitting them would change behavior, not structure.

excluded.args: Experimental in ansible-lint 26.11.0. Not a stable module-argument contract.
excluded.complexity: Experimental numeric threshold. Not an operational safety property.
excluded.event-query: Applies only to Ansible Automation Platform event_query.yml catalogs, which this tree does not ship.
excluded.galaxy: Galaxy and Automation Hub publication metadata. ansible/ is operational playbooks, not a published collection.
excluded.galaxy-version-incorrect: Requires a published collection version above 1.0.0. Same publication scope as galaxy.
excluded.meta-incorrect: Rewrites published role meta/main.yml defaults. Operational playbooks have no Galaxy metadata contract.
excluded.meta-no-tags: Galaxy tag character set for published content.
excluded.meta-runtime: Published collection runtime metadata. The pinned quality environment selects Ansible, not meta/runtime.yml.
excluded.meta-video-links: Galaxy video_links formatting, not an operational play property.
excluded.only-builtins: Experimental rule that forbids the pinned Kubernetes and other collections these plays intentionally use.
excluded.role-argument-spec: Galaxy role argument_spec publication file. Not required for internal playbook roles.
excluded.role-name: Role directory names are include and path contracts. They are not renamed to a Galaxy pattern without a consumer map.
excluded.var-naming: Would rename play and role variables that are external interfaces. Consumers are not remapped by a linter rule.
excluded.warning: Experimental catch-all. strict: true already fails warnings emitted by real rules.
excluded.yaml: ansible-lint runs a second yamllint with its own config. ci/quality/yamllint.yaml is the strict YAML authority for the whole tree.

omitted.dnsconfig-options: Forces ndots=2. Cluster DNS search behavior is an existing network contract, not a generic pod default.
omitted.exposed-services: Forbids NodePort and LoadBalancer. This homelab intentionally publishes selected services that way.
omitted.hpa-minimum-three-replicas: Forces three replicas. Capacity and single-writer data volumes are explicit constraints, not a replica quota.
omitted.minimum-three-replicas: Same replica quota. It would contradict measured-capacity and single-writer deployment intent.
omitted.no-node-affinity: Requires node affinity on every workload. Placement stays in the existing scheduler and inventory contracts.
omitted.no-rolling-update-strategy: Requires RollingUpdate. Recreate is required for single-writer ReadWriteOnce volumes.
omitted.priority-class-name: No cluster-wide priority class contract exists. The check would invent one.
omitted.required-annotation-email: Organization email annotation. Not a security or runtime property of this repository.
omitted.required-label-owner: Organization owner label. Not a security or runtime property of this repository.
omitted.restart-policy: Requires restartPolicy Always on deployment-like objects. Jobs and CronJobs intentionally use Never or OnFailure.
omitted.schema-validation: kube-linter ships an unlocked schema set. Checksum-locked kubeconform schemas at Kubernetes 1.36.0 remain the schema authority.

disabled.key-ordering: Unsatisfiable beside ansible-lint key-order. Task mappings use that semantic order, not Unicode alphabetical order, so both rules cannot pass on the same mapping.

generatedWorkflows.blocker: No generated workflow exemption: audit the scheduled publisher, preserve trusted base governance and never grant write permissions to PR execution.
